name: Prometheus MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to execute PromQL queries and discover metrics across multiple Prometheus tenants using the Model Context Protocol. It supports single and multi-tenant configurations with secure authentication for instant and range query analysis.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI assistants to execute PromQL queries and discover metrics across multiple Prometheus tenants using the Model Context Protocol. It supports single and multi-tenant configurations with secure authentication for instant and range query analysis.

ORG_ID.description: Organization ID for multi-tenant setups like Cortex, Mimir, or Thanos.

PROMETHEUS_URL.description: The URL of your Prometheus server (e.g., http://localhost:9090). Required for single-tenant configuration.

PROMETHEUS_TENANTS.description: A JSON string defining multiple Prometheus tenants. Required for multi-tenant configuration.

PROMETHEUS_DEFAULT_TENANT.description: The name of the default tenant (defaults to the first tenant in PROMETHEUS_TENANTS if not specified).
